messages:
marie (Design): dropped a tiny prototype: https://redwood.design/snapshots/2175000000_v1.png
marie (Design): main changes: compact token pill to the left of timestamp, streaming pulse that respects reduced-motion, and two action patterns: inline mini-stop, or trailing kebab menu with full actions. also experimenting with a drag-handle for prompt library cards. quick thoughts?
devin (Product): love the pill left placement 12 keeps actions grouped on the right. prefer kebab menu + inline stop for immediate cancels. want clear keyboard access + visible label for newcomers.
hugo (Eng): kebab + inline stop is easiest to implement and keeps DOM simple. notes: use AbortController for stop, send X-Cancel-Generation header to backend, and ensure client stops rendering new chunks after abort. for keyboard: put a single focusable "message actions" button that opens the menu.
tess (Research): token pill: show total tokens by default; when hovered or focused show breakdown tooltip: prompt / completion / cached. compact mode: show delta only during an active request. users in study confused by unlabeled icons 12 add short tooltips.
omar (QA): accessibility findings: pill color fails contrast at small sizes (currently ~3:1). need >=4.5:1 for body text. streaming currently fires aria-live on every chunk 12 noisy. instead: announce once at start ("Response streaming") and announce final content when done. also verify reduced-motion preference stops pulse animation.
marie (Design): copy question: inline label "Stop" and menu shows "Stop generation" / "Regenerate response"? or terse everywhere?
devin (Product): terse in-situ, explicit in menu. shortcuts: Esc to stop (when convo focused), Shift+R to regenerate (scope to convo to avoid browser conflicts).
hugo (Eng): we'll scope shortcuts to the conversation container. Regen will capture convo snapshot and re-run; assign regen_id for telemetry. Stop will abort stream + send cancel header. will add e2e that simulates flaky network and asserts server sees cancel.
tess (Research): prompt library drag-in: need clear insertion indicator and empty-state placeholder. keyboard users need an "Insert" button on each card and a keyboard shortcut (P to preview, Enter to insert). preview should populate a live region with a short summary.
omar (QA): test additions: keyboard-only insertion, VoiceOver/NVDA check for preview + insert, contrast checks at 12px, reduced-motion verified on Mac/Windows. also test mobile touch targets for floating control.
marie (Design): updated mock v2 with accessible labels, contrast tweaks, and focus states: https://redwood.design/snapshots/2175000000_v2.png
marie (Design): decision for devs: inline "Stop" chip + kebab menu with full labels; token pill left of timestamp; tooltip breakdown on focus/hover; respect prefers-reduced-motion. will upload final frames to Figma before EOD.
hugo (Eng): i'll spike the abort header and scoped shortcuts this sprint. will coordinate with QA for the cancellation tests. cc @tess for prompt-lib keyboard spec.
design-bot: Reminder 12 design review on Thu 9:30am PT. please attach final mock to the review doc by Wed EOD. :spiral_calendar_pad:
